independence_scope: Package reconciliation of coordinator report, gates, exact independent reviews and guarded handoff. Reviewer authored ponded-coal-ash and independently reviewed sulfates; coal scientific acceptance is exclusively the different phosphate reviewer, not this package audit.

limitations: Moore reports no ludlamite-specific sample masses, replicate counts, quantitative conversion uncertainty or mass balance. Product mineral identity remains unknown.
The heating observations are one mineral arm of the same original study used for phosphoferrite, not an independent replication.

This review examines primary full text and relevant figures/tables but does not reproduce the heating or assay. Earlier structural references were not reacquired and are not used as independent experimental support.
Searches were bounded to recorded queries and local roots including ignored/hidden files; no source-exhaustion claim. Hosted PR, queue and postmerge gates are outside this scientific review.
2009supplementary Table/CIF deposit was unavailable; printAM-09-052 versus current indexAM-09-062 remains unresolved. Detailed coordinates/raw-refinement reproducibility are excluded.
No experimentalHpositions for paracoquimbite; water count follows the stated structural model, with TGendpoint uncertainty retained.
Later2025boundary work and dataset remain discovery leads, not independently audited evidence in this record.
No microbial mechanism, isolated iron product balance, general equilibrium field or industrial deployment is established.
No experimental replication, raw assay reanalysis, percent-denominator reconstruction or model refitting was performed.

The primary lacks matched uninoculated/acid-only/sulfur-free controls, sulfur balance, explicit percent calculation and full metal balance. Its limited mobilization observation is retained without microbial partitioning, validated optimum, isolated product or scale-up claim.
Catalogue correspondence does not authenticate the source stocks or their mixing ratio. NCBI identifiers are species scoped, not unique experimental-strain identifiers.
Direct ATCC page routes had access errors earlier; current indexed official ATCC catalogue pages and independent NCBI pages plus retained NCBI efetch XML were inspected.

No additional formal correction/retraction surfaced within the retained exact author/title queries. Related dissertation and local-isolate papers were not accepted as full-text independent replication; source coverage is bounded.

The 2015 paper reports a mesh/unit inconsistency and discordant percentage/model text. These remain source limitations explicitly reflected in the owner; no unreported corrected particle size, denominator or fitted result was substituted.
Actual final assessment timestamps cover this native artifact assembly and exact binding reconciliation; full-source reading and inspect occurred earlier in the same review task.
The original calculated water, incomplete hydrogen positions, all-Fe scattering model and unresolved titanium distribution limit structural/compositional interpretation.
Source water-site wording conflicts with its hydroxyl assignments; the owner preserves the contradiction instead of silently repairing the source.

The 183-page supplement was checked for metadata, atomic model and reflection-table presence; this review is not an independent re-refinement, complete line-by-line reflection validation or raw diffraction reprocessing.
Searches were bounded to recorded queries and local roots including ignored/hidden files; no source-exhaustion claim. Hosted PR, queue and postmerge gates are outside this scientific review.
No raw-pattern re-refinement or direct atomic-mechanism reconstruction; the source-assigned phases and explicit limits are assessed.
2021original announces no separate supplement; an exhaustive live inventory/raw diffraction archive was not established.
One natural mixed powder and protocol-dependent endpoints cannot establish universal stability, microbial causation, isolated recovery or deployment.

open_source_issues.title: Clarify poultry-manure phosphorus fractions and contradictory Gaind 2016 figures
open_source_issues.summary: Poultry manure deferred pending attributable fraction/graphics clarification or independent primary evidence.

limitations: Package integrity and evidence-boundary check; no fresh independent scientific reassessment of the reviewer-authored coal owner.
Full source archives remain outside Git. Source hashes were checked where explicit file bindings exist; no raw-data reanalysis or coordinate refinement performed.

Native PR publication, hosted required checks, squash-shaped isolated preflight, queue merge, fresh-main verification, cleanup and Pages success remain future gates. No deployment or source-exhaustion assertion.
Runtime acceptance preserves its static-only scope and prior eight-test lineage; this audit does not pretend those tests ran again.
Original-main preservation receipt is checked against its before-manifest and current HEAD/status; guarded commit separately rechecks every nontracked byte/mode/link before mutation.
